caption: The video captures a close-up view of a clear glass bowl filled with round lemon slices resting on a pinkish wooden surface. A thin stream of clear liquid pours from a grayish vessel at the upper right, falling onto the central lemon slice and into the liquid already in the bowl. The falling column wavers and intermittently breaks into droplets as it travels downward. Bright splashes and ripples appear across the lemon flesh, scattering small highlights from frame to frame. The pouring vessel tilts and shifts slightly, changing the visible rim and the angle from which the stream emerges. The bowl and lemon slices remain mostly fixed, while minor handheld jitter keeps the softly blurred foreground rim close to the same position.
